resources.string: Speed alerts for employers and their drivers
Sign in with the Google account you want to use for this app.
For employers monitoring their own employed drivers only. Drivers see and agree to the monitoring in the app. All users must be 18 or older.
No Google account found on this phone. Add one in Settings > Accounts and try again.
I own or manage vehicles and want to monitor my employed drivers.
I drive for an employer who uses this app.
You can change this later as long as you are not linked to anyone.
You will switch to %1$s. This works only while you are not linked to anyone.
Ask your admin to open the app, tap Add driver, and send you the 6-digit code on WhatsApp or by phone.
Your admins will see your location and speed only during trips. Trips arrive in Phase 2.
They will be able to see
Your live location and speed during trips
The battery level of your phone and whether tracking is working
Your trip history: date, duration, distance and top speed
Alerts, for example when you go over the speed limit or press SOS
Only during trips that you start, or that an admin asks you to start. Outside trips the app sends a short status check (battery, tracking working) every 30 minutes, without location.
Your calls, messages, other apps, or your location outside trips.
You can remove this admin at any time from \"Who can see my data\".
Sees your live location and speed during trips, battery, trip history and alerts.
%1$s will stop seeing your data. This ends the whole link, so your second admin is removed too. You will need a new code to pair again.
%1$s will stop seeing your data. Your primary admin stays.
Tap Add driver to get a 6-digit code and send it to your driver. Or tap Join as second admin if a primary admin gave you a code.
Send this code to your driver on WhatsApp or by phone. They install the app, choose Driver, sign in with Google and enter it.
Send this code to the person who will be the second admin. They install the app, choose Admin, and tap Join as second admin. Your driver then has to agree in their app.
Driver Safety Monitor code: %1$s\nInstall the app, choose Driver, sign in with Google and enter this code. It is valid for 10 minutes.
Driver Safety Monitor second-admin code: %1$s\nInstall the app, choose Admin, tap Join as second admin and enter this code. It is valid for 10 minutes.
Enter the 6-digit code the primary admin gave you. The driver has to agree before you see anything.
Live map, speed, settings and trips arrive in Phase 3.
The driver has not agreed yet. You will see their data after they tap Agree.
This ends monitoring for %1$s. The second admin is removed too. The driver needs a new code to pair again.
You will stop seeing %1$s. The primary admin stays.
No connection. Check the internet and try again.
Server function not found. Deploy the Cloud Functions (Phase 1 guide, step 6).
Please sign out and sign in again.
Wrong code. Check the 6 digits and try again.
This code was already used. Ask for a new one.
This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
This code is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
You are already linked to an admin. Remove that admin first.
Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
Only the primary admin can do this.
This driver already has a second admin. Remove them first.
Nothing is waiting for your approval.
Remove all links before changing your role.
You are already the primary admin of this driver.
